tree entry object

  • CURIE: gmeow:treeEntryObject
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/treeEntryObject
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

The content-addressed object (Blob or SourceTree) that a tree entry points to. Functional: one object per entry.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:TreeEntry -> gmeow:SourceNode; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:treeEntryObject from gmeow:TreeEntry to gmeow:SourceNode when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:TreeEntry, gmeow:SourceNode
